summary: Americas Gold and Silver Corporation filed a Form 6-K providing its Notice of Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders and Management Information Circular for the meeting scheduled June 23, 2026. The meeting covers routine items: receiving financial statements, electing directors, and reappointing auditors. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or tender offer is disclosed. The filing is a routine procedural document under Canadian notice-and-access provisions, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
